about_title: Clinical depth, faith and culture in one conversation.
about_text:
Philip Dimka is a clinical psychologist, trauma therapist and play therapist based in Jos, Plateau State. His work spans Child-Centred Play Therapy, Theraplay, EMDR and trauma-informed care, with a focus on conflict-affected and displaced communities in North Central Nigeria.

He moves between the clinic, the church and the community, translating psychology into language people can use at home, in the pulpit and in the classroom.
